press-black.$description: Press Black — Body text, all borders, pill outlines, button strokes — the sole ink color, used at full opacity for every foreground element

bone-white.$description: Bone White — Page canvas, card surfaces, pill fills — the only surface color, creating maximum contrast against Press Black

smoke-gray.$description: Smoke Gray — Hairline dividers, muted outlines, secondary borders where a softer separation is needed

standard.$description: Display and heading type only — a custom geometric sans used at two large sizes with extreme negative tracking (-0.045em to -0.054em). Also sets link and button text. The single weight (400) and tight tracking create a compressed, poster-like presence that dominates the page. No bold variant exists; hierarchy is achieved through size and tracking alone.

times.$description: Body and micro-copy type — the system serif at 13px, used in editorial contexts (footnotes, annotations, fine print). The serif/sans collision with Standard is deliberate: the sans shouts, the serif footnotes.
